content: Official Go release history confirms Go 1.27.3 includes x509 security fixes. modernc sqlite v1.61.1 requires Go 1.26 and libc v1.79.0; upstream docs show Linux amd64 and arm64 support and SQLite 3.54.1. Prefer pure Go driver subject to native architecture durability and throughput tests. SQLite WAL requires synchronous FULL for acknowledged commits to survive power failure and requires local filesystem. Go race tests still require cgo and C compiler.
